source.publisher: East Antrim Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: only nomination recorded for the division. 'Other East Antrim nominations are ... Ballyclare, Alexander McConnell; Islandmagee, Robert S. Sproule; Larne, Aubrey H. Girvan' with only Carrickfergus and Newtownabbey contested in East Antrim (East Antrim Times, 21 May 1964, p. 1).

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council. The official notice (Irish News, 7 May 1964, p. 2) fixed the day of election as Thursday 4 June 1964; nomination day was Tuesday 19 May and withdrawals closed at 5 p.m. on Wednesday 20 May. Three divisions went to a poll on 4 June: Ballymoney, Carrickfergus and Newtownabbey. The returning officer's 'County of Antrim: notice of result of elections, 1964' (Belfast Newsletter, 6 June 1964, p. 10) names the member elected for every division, including the twenty-one returned unopposed; it also prints Finaghy, which the earlier nomination notice had omitted. Unopposed return; no vote recorded. Returned unopposed.
